title: Why Are Pine Seeds Naked? Explained Simply | PUC Biology Class 11
description:
Aarav picks up a pine cone on a hill station trip, shakes it, and small seeds fall out from between its scales. Why is there no fruit around them? This lesson covers gymnosperms, the plants with naked seeds, from NCERT Class 11 Biology, Chapter 3, Plant Kingdom.

You will see what gymnos and sperma mean, the body of a gymnosperm (Sequoia, tap roots, mycorrhiza in Pinus, coralloid roots with cyanobacteria in Cycas) and a live zoom ladder from a pine tree to its female cone, one scale and an ovule with its nucellus, female gametophyte and archegonia. Five animated stages show pollen grains forming, megaspores, pollination by air, the pollen tube and the naked seed. A labelled needle section explains how pines save water, step by step, and Pinus and Cycas are compared side by side. Then a worked example, the exam trap about the pollen grain, an original NEET pattern match the following question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

This is Episode 25 of our PUC Biology series.
Made for PUC (Karnataka), CBSE Class 11 and NEET students.
